officialSendingAgency.name: Center of Overseas Labor (COLAB), Ministry of Home Affairs
officialSendingAgency.address: 01 Trịnh Hoài Đức, Phường Ô Chợ Dừa, Hà Nội, Việt Nam

evidenceNotes: Vietnam's 2026 EPS recruitment notice is published by COLAB under the Ministry of Home Affairs and identifies COLAB as the sole authorized body for sending Vietnamese workers under EPS.
The 2026 manufacturing target is 3,000 workers; Round 1 is computer-based EPS-TOPIK plus color-vision screening, followed by mandatory skill testing.

The official September 2026 Round 1 result notice sets the manufacturing cutoff at 150 points and says successful Round 1 candidates are automatically registered for Round 2; the official Round 2 schedule is to be announced after HRD Korea confirmation.

The initial official 2026 COLAB plan projected Manufacturing Round 2 for 2026-10-12 through 2026-10-16. The later verified Round 1 result notice still requires a separate HRD-confirmed official schedule, so KEP records 2026-10-12 only as a dated recheck trigger and does not promote the projected window as final.
KEP keeps Vietnam on research HOLD while exact current manufacturing medical, candidate-file submission, visa, training and departure rules are mapped.

As rechecked on 2026-10-06, COLAB's original plan still shows Manufacturing Round 2 as projected for 2026-10-12 through 2026-10-16, while the later Round 1 result notice still says the official skill-test schedule will be announced after HRD Korea confirmation. KEP therefore treats 2026-10-12 as a review trigger, not a final test date.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.action: Check the 2026 Vietnam EPS eligibility conditions: age 18–39, legal/criminal and Korea-stay history, Vietnam exit eligibility, family illegal-stay condition, health/color-vision requirements, and any sector-specific conditions.

stages.title: In-person EPS-TOPIK registration
stages.action: The 2026 official receiving-location notice accepted EPS exam registrations from 2026-03-23 through 2026-03-27. Registration was in person at the official receiving point; proxy registration was not allowed. This window is closed.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK registration fee
stages.action: The 2026 official test-registration fee is the VND equivalent of US$28. Pay only through the official registration process.

stages.title: Identity / anti-fraud verification
stages.action: Bring the chip-based Citizen ID as required for identity scanning and matching. Do not rely on another person's document or mismatched identity data.

stages.title: Registration document verification
stages.action: Verify Citizen ID data, application data and photo before registration. Personal identity data used through the EPS process must match and should not be assumed correctable later.

stages.title: Exam schedule / admission preparation
stages.action: Use COLAB's official exam-session and location notice for your assigned manufacturing test session and bring the required original identity document.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK — Round 1
stages.action: The 2026 manufacturing Round 1 is computer-based Korean testing plus color-vision checking. Reading and listening total 40 questions over 50 minutes, with 200 maximum points.

stages.title: Skill test — Round 2
stages.action: Manufacturing candidates who passed Round 1 are automatically registered for the mandatory skill test. The initial COLAB plan projected 2026-10-12 through 2026-10-16, but the later Round 1 result notice says the official schedule will be announced after HRD Korea confirmation. Recheck official COLAB/HRD sources on 2026-10-12; do not treat the projected window as final.

stages.title: Point-based final selection
stages.action: Passing Round 1 and the mandatory skill test is required before an applicant may submit the employment-candidate file. Passing tests does not guarantee a Korean employer selection or departure.

stages.title: Country-specific pre-job checks
stages.action: No separate Vietnam psychology stage is asserted from the current 2026 recruitment notice. Do not copy Indonesia-specific psychology rules.

stages.title: Medical examination
stages.action: Health eligibility is required, but KEP has not yet promoted an exact current-2026 manufacturing medical-provider/checklist notice. Use only the applicable COLAB notice when published.

stages.title: Employment-candidate file
stages.action: Only workers who pass both selection rounds may submit the file to register as candidates for work in Korea. The 2026 official forms page provides the current candidate-file forms; exact cohort submission instructions remain under review.

stages.title: Candidate / job-seeker roster
stages.action: After COLAB verifies the candidate file, the official EPS process sends eligible records to Korea for employer selection. No private intermediary can guarantee roster priority.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.action: Wait for employer selection through the official EPS process. COLAB is the authorized Vietnamese sending body; a private broker cannot guarantee employer selection.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.action: If selected by a Korean employer, follow the current COLAB notice for the labor contract and the next required steps. Do not pay a private broker to obtain or alter an SLC.

stages.title: Post-SLC Vietnam requirements
stages.action: Follow the current COLAB notice for post-contract training, health, documents, fees and departure preparation. Older process pages are not treated as exact 2026 fee rules.

stages.title: Visa document package
stages.action: Use the current COLAB visa-document notice and current official forms. Exact 2026 manufacturing visa checklist and charges remain under review.

stages.title: Pre-departure orientation
stages.action: COLAB publishes 2026 orientation-course notices. Attend only the course assigned by the official notice; exact cohort timing remains notice-specific.

stages.title: Final health/departure readiness
stages.action: COLAB's process includes final health readiness before departure, but exact current-2026 requirements must come from the assigned departure notice.

stages.title: Official departure
stages.action: Travel only under COLAB's official departure plan after all current contract, visa, training and health requirements are completed.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.action: After entry, complete the official Korea-side employment education and handover process.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts during the official handover.

stages.title: Residence Card / foreigner registration
stages.action: After arrival, follow current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: EPS insurance check
stages.action: Confirm required EPS insurance obligations through official EPS information.

stages.title: First payroll check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the SLC, working hours, deductions and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor support readiness
stages.action: Keep official labor-support routes and contract/payroll evidence ready for any wage or labor issue.

stages.title: Employment / workplace-change readiness
stages.action: If a legally recognized workplace-change reason occurs, use Korea's official EPS or employment-center process and observe applicable deadlines.

round2ReviewTrigger.rule: Recheck COLAB on 2026-10-12 and daily during the projected window, but do not promote 2026-10-12 through 2026-10-16 as the final Round 2 schedule until COLAB publishes the HRD Korea-confirmed official schedule.
